They are strongly committed to justice, transparency, and equal treatment, even when doing so is inconvenient or costly. - This participant tends to be highly altruistic and strongly motivated to help others. They are readily moved by music, art, design, poetry, or a striking view, often experiencing strong emotional reactions to them, and may feel drawn to expressing themselves creatively. Aesthetic experience often plays a central role in how they engage with their environment and in what they find meaningful.
